algorithm: VINN (BYOL nearest-neighbor) vs. Behavior Cloning / BC-Rep
success_criterion: per task, e.g. "success if the robot is able to rotate the object by 90 degrees under a minute" (Planar Rotation)
headline_value: VINN 10/10 (Planar Rotation), 9/10 (Object Flipping), 10/10 (Can Spinning), 10/10 (Bottle Opening), 3/10 (Card Sliding), 3/10 (PostIt Note Sliding); BC and BC-Rep 0/10 on every task; generalization to novel objects (5 rollouts x 10 objects = 50 trials/task): 35/50, 50/50, 45/50
operator_interface: VR headset (Meta Quest 2), built-in 4-camera hand tracker, no glove/exoskeleton
retargeting_objective: direct joint-angle copy for index/middle/ring fingers; thumb fingertip position matched via inverse kinematics; pinky ignored (no cost function or optimization)
latency: under 100 ms on a local network (Sec. IV-D)
